selection: Exactly the 72 content-addressed finite geometry batches needed by the 32 basic anchor vertices. Tables were regenerated by the pinned unmodified source verifier; all integer maxima are retained verbatim.
verification_scope: Pinned input to rational prefix postprocessing. Input hashes certify identity; this input does not itself prove the geometry maxima, infinite-height comparison, probability construction or physical-prime transport. No Lean replay is claimed.
cache_file_hash_format: sha256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(integer_maxima,separators=(comma,colon)) followed by one newline
